explanation.headline: FDA records show the plant on our olanzapine label received OAI classifications in 2017 and 2021, and three Class II/III recalls for olanzapine since 2022

sentences.text: The olanzapine product on our formulary (NDC 33342008411) lists Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3007517881) as the manufacturing plant.
FDA inspection 1032020 ended 2017-11-24 and was classified OAI with nine observations including absent written procedures and inadequate laboratory controls.
FDA inspection 1157334 ended 2021-11-01 and was also classified OAI.
The most recent inspection 1220834 ended 2023-10-20 and returned to VAI classification.

Since 2022, three recalls have been initiated for Macleods olanzapine tablets: a Class II recall in 2022 for cGMP deviations, a Class II recall in 2024 for failed impurity specifications, and a Class III recall in 2026 for organic and unspecified impurities above specification.
Current inventory across our three sites ranges from 12 to 29 days on hand.

Q-6f99f0.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%olanzapine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%olanzapine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-1f5d33.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('df43938a-3469-40eb-8166-f0a2fd29d6d8') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-8f4faa.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%olanzapine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-bdd72c.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%olanzapine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-52698c.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%olanzapine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-e2268d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3007517881') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-cdeb14.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3007517881') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-3307b6.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3007517881') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('macleods')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-897e2a.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('macleods') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%olanzapine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-660c9d.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1032020', '1157334') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-d262dc.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('33342008411')
